svg.aria-label: A radio wave split into I and Q
svg.text: ① The radio wave at the antenna (drawn slowed down: really 204 million cycles per second)
the transmitter changes amplitude and phase here
② The same wave = a cosine part + a sine part at the tuned frequency (the two add up to ①)
③ What the stick sends: only the weights I and Q, sampled 2 048 000 times a second
The fast carrier is gone; I and Q only change when the transmitted information changes.
cosine axis, Q on the sine
